**daemon:** `targets_facts` no longer pays a full-tree content hash and a serial per-keyword content probe on every request. The freshness check now runs `tree_delta_cached` — the same stat-keyed memo `ensure_graph` uses — and `probe_content` probes each keyword on its own scoped thread. On the pinned Pixel bench clone a heavy prompt's relevance op goes from ~950 ms to ~250 ms server-side, under the brief window that dropped late replies as `unjudged` empty briefs.
